content.title: Haleon Shares Fall on Cut to Organic Revenue Guidance
content.summary: Haleon  shares fell on Thursday after the company cut its organic-revenue growth targets for 2025, with weaker sales in North America dragging top-line results in the first half of the year.  The maker of Sensodyne toothpaste and Panadol medicines trimmed its full-year organic revenue growth guidance to around 3.5% from the 4%-6% guided previously.  Instead, that 4%-6% target would form part of its guidance from 2026, which also includes high-single digit adjusted operating profit growth at constant currency.
